title: Checkbox
description: Lets users select one or more options, with indeterminate, error and custom styling support.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: An uncontrolled checkbox with a label; use defaultChecked for the initial state.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Pass checked and onChange. onChange receives the new checked state and the change event.

indeterminate.title: Indeterminate
indeterminate.description: A "select all" checkbox that is indeterminate while only some items are selected.

sizes-and-shapes.title: Sizes and shapes
sizes-and-shapes.description: Three sizes and three box shapes: square (default), rounded and circle.

label-placement.title: Label placement
label-placement.description: Place the label at the start, end (default), top or bottom of the box.

states.title: States
states.description: Disabled checkboxes, and required for use in native forms.

custom-style.title: Custom style
custom-style.description: Customize the box, border and checkmark colors, or show a custom icon when checked.

error.title: Error state
error.description: error with helperText highlights a checkbox that needs attention.

CheckboxProps.indeterminate: Shows the indeterminate (partially checked) state. Controlled: it stays applied until this prop changes, also after the user clicks
CheckboxProps.name: Name of the input, used in forms
CheckboxProps.onChange: Called with the new checked state and the change event
CheckboxProps.label: Label text
CheckboxProps.ariaLabel: Accessible label, required when there is no visible label
CheckboxProps.errorIcon: Icon shown before the helper text in the error state
CheckboxProps.helperText: Helper or error text shown below the checkbox (linked with aria-describedby)
CheckboxProps.labelPlacement: Position of the label relative to the box
